text:
Predicates:
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
DiamondMine(wwe) ∧ RoderickStrong(roderick) ∧ Leads(roderick, diamondMine) ∧ Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ∧ Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ∧ Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a WWE stable led by Roderick Strong, including the Creed Brothers and Ivy Nile, and Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Leads(roderick, creedBrothers) ::: Roderick Strong leads the Creed Brothers.
